Located in Arlington, we specialize in residential and commercial fencing. All of our fences are custom built to meet the home/business owners’ needs. Whether it is a beautiful fence to add to the visual appeal or a privacy fence to make your family or coworkers feel more secure, A&O Texas Solutions has the answer. Our professionals at A&O Texas Solutions go through extensive training to ensure that they are equipped with the right knowledge and skills to create a high caliber fence that surpasses our client’s expectations. Please leave this field empty. What areas do you serve We serve all cities withing the DFW metroplex area If you’re unsure whether you’re within our service area, please contact us. How long has A&O Texas Solutions been in business? A&O Texas Solutions has been providing high-quality privacy fencing and patio services for over 20 years, with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and craftsmanship. How do you determine the cost of a fencing or patio project? The cost of each project is determined by several factors, including the size of the area, the materials selected, and the complexity of the design. Get a free, no-obligation estimate to provide you with an accurate quote. What payment methods do you accept? We accept various payment methods, including cash, check, Zelle and major credit cards. Payment plans or financing options are also available. Please contact us for more details. How long does it take to install a fence? The timeline for fence installation can vary depending on the project’s complexity, size, and material availability. Generally, most fence installations are completed within 2 to 3 days after the start date. Do I need to be present during the installation? While you don’t necessarily need to be present for the entire installation process, we recommend being available on the first and last day to ensure everything meets your satisfaction. Can A&O Texas Solutions help with patio design and installation? Absolutely! Be it pergolas, patio covers, decks or outdoor kitchens. We provide comprehensive patio design and installation services to transform your outdoor space into a beautiful and functional area. Call now and one of our experts will assist you 8174386683 Do you offer custom fence designs? Yes, we offer custom fence design services to meet the unique needs and visions of our clients. Whether you have a specific design in mind or need assistance creating one, our experts are here to help. Get a free estimate now What kind of maintenance do your fences require? Maintenance requirements vary by material. Wood fences may need periodic staining or sealing, while vinyl and metal fences require minimal maintenance. We will provide you with all the necessary care instructions for your specific fence type. Does A&O Texas Solutions offer a warranty on their fences and patios? Yes, we offer a warranty covering materials and workmanship. The length and specifics of the warranty depend on the materials used and the scope of the project. We will provide detailed warranty information at the time of your estimate. How can I get a quote for my project? You can get a quote by filling up our estimate form , contact us by phone , or email . We’ll schedule a consultation to discuss your needs and assess your property. Who can I contact if I have more questions? Our customer service team is available to answer any questions you may have. Please reach out to us via phone , email , or through our website’s contact form .
